name: Pip
conversations: Oh! Hi! Don't look at the bed, I made it myself. Mostly. The pillow helped.
If you lie really still by the window at night, you can see the Great Tree twinkle. Mum says it's fireflies. I say it's waving.
I'm going to be a sky-sailor when I grow up. I'll visit ALL the islands!
Leafwind first, because they have kites the size of houses. Then Barkton, because I heard their bread is shaped like logs. That's just good design.
Teddy says hello. He's very shy. He's been to Seedhaven, you know. Well. He was MADE in Seedhaven.
That counts as travelling. I've decided.
At the Festival of Falling Leaves we throw the leaves UP instead of down. Nobody knows why!
I asked Elder Moss and he said 'tradition'. I asked again and he gave me a biscuit. I think the biscuit means he doesn't know either.
